name: Pleiades
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the Pleiades are part of God's sovereign creation, alongside other celestial bodies such as Arcturus and Orion, demonstrating His power over the universe (Job 9:9). In Job 38:31, God challenges human ability to control the Pleiades, highlighting His unique authority in binding or loosing these stars. Amos 5:8 further emphasizes that the Lord is the Creator of the seven stars, including the Pleiades, affirming His dominion over both the heavens and the earth, and His power to bring light and darkness according to His will.
